peak_pose: sitting on an invisible ledge facing the viewer, hands planted beside her hips, leaning slightly forward with her chest pushed forward, one leg slowly crossed over the other, boots dangling
expression: bedroom eyes on the viewer and a slow lip bite
motion: Seated, she slowly uncrosses and recrosses her legs, leaning her chest forward as the top leg lifts; her chest and thighs give a soft, weighty settle-bounce as the leg lands; she holds the lean with a smirk, then sits back; hips stay planted on the seat line the whole time.
name: sit_cross_legs
